Description
Luxurious urban living at iconic Jameson House by Norman Foster. This apartment is located on the 28th floor facing East and provides amazing city, mountain and water views. Spacious open floor plan with premium finishes throughout. 9 ft ceilings, infloor radiant heating & cooling, contemporary kitchens by Dada Cucina of Italy, Gaggeneau & Sub Zero appliances. Includes 1 parking spot with auto-valet parking system & 24 hour concierge for your convenience. Min 1 year lease required.
